title: Hacker House Medellín (Dioxus SSR)
description: The Dioxus server-rendered front end. Same three-route shape as hhm-leptos-web, rendered by dioxus_ssr and served on its own port.

Health.doc: Built inline with serde_json::json!, so the field names below are the whole contract.

ui.doc: Constant `dioxus-ssr` -- identifies which front end answered.

healthz.summary: Liveness, plus which front end answered.
